name: network

frames.best_why: Frame 2 shows a bright connection line across the rings with names popped up at its ends.

tagline: Rings of portraits circle a centre while a coloured line links two people.
summary: A circular diagram of two dashed rings packed with small portrait avatars around a larger central one. Every few seconds a glowing coloured line draws between two random people and their names appear as little labels.
appearance: A dark field with two faint dashed circles, the outer ring crowded with small round portraits and the inner ring a little smaller, all around one large central face. Small white name pills float above a few avatars.
behaviour: Every four seconds the previous link vanishes and a new coloured line draws itself between two random portraits while their name pills fade in; hovering any avatar also reveals its name. The whole layout rescales with the window.
demo_content: Two dozen stock portraits with names like Zane Whitaker, Maya, Jordan, Avery and Quinn around a Center Hub.
search_phrases: circle of faces connected by lines
use_when: A section should convey many people connected around one hub, such as a community or team map.
avoid_when: Names and portraits are hardcoded inside the file, so adapting it to real people means editing the source.
customise: It takes no props: the portrait URLs, names, ring counts and timing are fixed in the file, so adapting it means editing the arrays and the four-second interval.
weight_why: Two dozen avatar images plus one SVG line that redraws every four seconds.

a11y.note: Names only appear on hover or while linked, and nothing is focusable, so keyboard users never see them.

issues: Names and portraits are baked in, so feeding it real people requires editing the component.
The dashed rings are so faint on the dark stage that the two-ring structure barely reads.
polish_why: Lively random connections over a full avatar field; faint rings and hardcoded data cap it.
title: Network
